name: Thompson Nashville
positioning: Midcentury-modern-inspired boutique high-rise in Nashville's Gulch neighborhood, near Broadway, with a ground-floor seafood restaurant and a rooftop bar
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable Gulch base near Broadway and Music Row
Families who want connecting rooms, with kids staying free

facts.text: Thompson Nashville is a boutique hotel in The Gulch neighborhood near Broadway.
The hotel is just steps from Broadway's honky-tonks, Bridgestone Arena, Music Row, the Frist Art Museum and Geodis Park.
Every guest room and suite has floor-to-ceiling windows, sliding barn doors and a rainfall shower.
Rooms have hardwood floors, and king beds are dressed in Sferra linens.
Marsh House, on the ground floor, focuses on responsibly sourced seafood and Southern-inspired cuisine, with a raw bar.
Marsh House's wine list features more than 400 labels.
Killebrew Coffee is the lobby-level coffee shop, with a pastry counter.
In-room dining from Marsh House is available day, night and overnight.
Dogs are welcome at no additional charge.
Valet parking is available at the hotel entrance, with in-and-out privileges.
Kids stay free, cribs can be requested, and connecting rooms are available.
The hotel rises 12 stories, and its decor is midcentury-modern inspired, with natural wood and neutral colors.

highlights.text: L.A. Jackson is the top-floor indoor-outdoor rooftop bar with views of The Gulch, craft cocktails and shareable bites; DJs play on select weekends.
Guest room minibars are stocked with local treats including Tennessee spirits, and each room has a cocktail shaker.
The famous wings mural is just across the street from the hotel.
The lobby floor is made from reclaimed wood from the neighborhood.
Each floor has hydration stations with filtered sparkling and still water.

considerations.text: A daily destination fee is applied to each room.
The L.A. Jackson rooftop bar is 21 and over.
WhataHotel notes a higher price point that reflects the luxury positioning.
